function:public.identity_delete_expired_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.identity_delete_expired_api_keys()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM public.identity_api_keys WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM removed$function$

function:public.identity_invitation_invi.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.identity_invitation_inviter(invitation_id bigint)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$SELECT m.account_id FROM public.household_invitations i JOIN public.household_memberships m ON m.id=i.invited_by_membership_id AND m.household_id=i.household_id WHERE i.id=invitation_id AND i.email=(SELECT a.email FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.id=med_tracker.current_account_id() AND a.status=2)$function$

policy:public.household_invitations.iden.using:
((accepted_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (email = ( SELECT a.email
   FROM accounts a
  WHERE ((a.id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (a.status = 2) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM account_lockouts l
          WHERE ((l.account_id = a.id) AND (l.deadline > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM identity_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.account_id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (s.token = NULLIF(current_setting('med_tracker.identity_session_token'::text, true), ''::text)) AND s.active AND (s.purpose = 'authenticated'::text) AND (s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))
